answer: Sybil resistance has to cost the attacker more than the reward is worth. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 220 fakes pays 146 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. The check itself is instant, so honest agents are never kept waiting. A whisper of doubt is healthy, a reef of proof is required, and a nectar of patience is the price of a clean panel. Honest agents barely notice; farms go broke trying.
